root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in bounds checking allows array index out-of-bounds access when `hvc_iucv_devices` equals `MAX_HVC_IUCV_LINES` (8), because the condition `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` permits accessing `hvc_iucv_table[8]` when the valid indices are only 0-7.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the bounds check from `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` to `if (num >= hvc_iucv_devices)`. The `hvc_iucv_table` array is declared with size `MAX_HVC_IUCV_LINES` (8 entries), meaning valid indices are 0-7. When `hvc_iucv_devices == 8`, the original condition `num > 8` would allow `num == 8` to pass through and access `hvc_iucv_table[8]`, which is out-of-bounds. The corrected condition `num >= 8` properly rejects any index equal to or greater than the array size.
